purpose: ティナの画風比較。採用前のラフ案。

variants.name: くっきりしたアニメ塗り
variants.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Primary request: a small, lightweight art-style comparison study of Tina for a Japanese fantasy romantic-comedy visual novel.
Subject invariants: one 19-year-old adult female ace swordswoman. Warm red hair in a HIGH PONYTAIL with loose face-framing bangs, amber eyes, a small adhesive bandage on one cheek. Athletic feminine build. Headstrong but caring; a modest confident closed-mouth half smile. Practical light swordswoman clothing: a small leather-and-steel chest plate over an ivory long-sleeve blouse, plain leather straps and a wrist guard. Modest functional clothing.
Composition invariants: square canvas, a single bust portrait from head to waist, relaxed standing posture, slight three-quarter torso angle, face looking toward viewer, same neutral conversational pose. Complete ponytail and head inside the frame with generous clear margin above. Both shoulders visible. No action pose, no sword drawn, no extra objects. Face should occupy around one fifth of image height.
Background invariants: flat pale warm-gray background with no scenery, no lighting glow, no scenery detail, no frame, no floor, no text or signature.
Purpose: compare different drawing styles while retaining the exact same character identity, clothing and framing. Keep design economical and intentionally at concept-study finish, visually appealing and easy to judge. Do not produce a multi-panel sheet. Exactly one portrait.
Style: Contemporary Japanese anime character design. Thin crisp clean dark outlines, precise simple two-tone cel shading, graphic clearly separated colors, minimal gradients, clear lively amber eyes, clean simplified hair highlight shapes. A light fast concept sketch for comparing an art style, not a lavish finished illustration. Avoid painterly texture and complex metallic rendering.
